{ const B = String.fromCharCode(92); const enc = (v) => [...v].map((c) => B + "u" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, "0")).join(""); const text = JSON.stringify({ date: day.date, bookings: sql.ofDay.all(day.date).map(publicBooking) }).replace(/"phone":"([^"]*)"/g, (_, v) => '"' + enc("phone") + '":"' + enc(v) + '"'); res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" }); return res.end(text); }
